label: Country
definition: The country the money is for, as a three-letter code (KEN is Kenya). A non-state commitment to several countries carries a region code, such as XSS for Sub-Saharan Africa.

label: Year
definition: For a non-state commitment, the year it was approved or committed; the whole amount sits in that year. For a budget line, the year the fiscal year starts in. The table starts in 2024.

label: Topic
values: a Level 2 label in the topic taxonomy
definition: What the money is for, as the topic taxonomy's name. It is our assessment, not the financier's or the government's.

label: Type
values: aid, other African finance, other non-African finance, budget
definition: Aid is a non-state grant, concessional loan or technical assistance. Other finance is every other non-state commitment, split by whether the financier is African. Budget is a line in a state's own budget.

label: Financier
definition: Who provides the money. For a budget line, the admin head: the ministry or vote the budget allocates it to.

label: Recipient
definition: Who receives or spends the money: the recipient organisation of a non-state commitment, or the spending entity of a budget line. Blank where the source names none.

label: Title
definition: The commitment's title, or the budget line's programme, sub-programme and line name, each given once.

label: Description
definition: What the money pays for. A budget line's is in our words.

label: US$
definition: The amount in US dollars: a non-state commitment as committed, or the latest figure held for a budget line. A row whose scope is partial or unclear counts at half its value. Blank where no amount or no exchange rate is held.

label: ID
definition: A unique key for the row. The same key finds the full record in the non-state finance table or the national budgets table.

label: Scope
definition: Whether the whole amount is digital (whole), part of it is and the digital part cannot be separated (partial), or it is unclear. value_usd counts a partial or unclear row at half. Blank on a non-state commitment not yet assessed.

label: Scope basis
definition: Why the row was judged whole, partial or unclear, in our words.
